name: home
description: Home — a self-hosted personal/family cloud ecosystem. This root package.json exists purely to tie every Node-based service and frontend together as one npm workspace, so `npm install` at the repo root installs everything in one pass instead of eight separate `cd X && npm install` steps. It is not itself published or run.
//workspaces: Every folder listed here has its own package.json and can still be developed independently (cd into it, npm run dev, as SETUP.md §4 describes). Listing them explicitly here — rather than a glob like 'apps/*' — is deliberate: apps/homesync-android is a Kotlin/Gradle project with no package.json, and an explicit list means a future new app under apps/ is NOT silently picked up as a workspace until someone adds it here on purpose.
//version-policy: See VERSIONING.md. Short version: this is ONE version number for the whole ecosystem while everything still evolves together tightly (pre-1.0, heavy v0 churn). Individual services get their own independent version numbers only once they're genuinely independently deployable — see MIGRATION_PLAN.md for what that unlocks.

scripts.//test: Runs every workspace's own `test` script, one at a time, stopping at the first failure. Equivalent to (but shorter than) cd-ing into backend, homemedia-backend, homenotes-backend, homesync-backend, and homecore/test one by one.
scripts.//install:all: Redundant with plain `npm install` once workspaces are set up (that already installs every workspace's deps) — kept as an explicit, discoverable alias for anyone skimming this file.
scripts.//docker:up: The actual way this whole ecosystem normally runs — see SETUP.md. This script is just a memorable shortcut.
